report.explanation: Alert asks whether evidence supports a root cause. Current telemetry is healthy: checkout span OK at 69ms, order p95 79ms, error_rate 0.0014, zero db pool waiters and dependency timeouts, INFO 200 logs. No taxonomy cause is substantiated and no bounded alternative is established, so hand off rather than assert a cause.
missing_evidence: No error or latency signal in traces, metrics, or logs to substantiate any taxonomy cause (http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak, bad-configuration).
No per-dependency latency or timeout data for order->inventory, order->payment, order->postgresql, or inventory->redis.
No memory-retention time series to assess a leak; single sample of 48MB is insufficient.
No deployment records to correlate version changes with behavior.
